newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Volusia County, Fla..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Volusia County, Fla..

text.p: Sales Tax Improvement Revenue Bonds, Series 1996
Sealed bids will be received by Volusia County, Florida (the Issuer'')at the office

Financial Officer,County Administration Building, 3rd Floor, 123 West Indiana Avenue, DeLand, FL 32720 for the purchase of the above-referenced Bonds, subject to the provisions of the Official Notice of Sale, until 11:00 a.m., EST on

or such other date (which later date shall not be earlier than ten (10) days nor later than sixty (60) days from the date of publication hereof) to be communicated through Munifacts News Service at least twenty-four(24) hours prior to such alternate sale date (the Bid Date''). In lieu of submitting sealed bids by hard copy, bidders may submit proposals via facsimile transmission, or
electronically via PARITY in accordance with its Rules of Participation, all as provided in the Official Notice of Sale.

Insurance: Financial Security Assurance Inc. has committed to issue its municipal bond insurance policy guaranteeing payment of principal and interest on the Series 1996 Bonds. Rating: The Bonds have been rated by Moody' A'' by Fitch. It is anticipated that Moody's will rate the Bonds Aaa'', based on the FSA insurance policy.

Bids may be submitted only on Official Bid Forms attached to the Official Notice of Sale. Copies of the Official Notice of Sale, the Preliminary Official Statement and Official Bid Forms, may be obtained from Government
Financial Advisors, Inc., 174 W. Comstock Avenue, Suite 220, Winter Park, Florida 32789, telephone (407) 740-8383,
